text_block_list.text:
The deadline for the submission of these
documents 
'miraculously' overlapped,
but somehow I managed 
to finish them. During a break――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming in! ……Trainer-san, you alive~? 
I brought you something!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~,
you look exhausted again.
You probably haven't even eat 
yet, huh?
I guess coming here was the right call.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Go on,
eat this.
I washed it already and it's still cold! 
You could eat it right now.

Katsuragi Ace's thoughfulness almost brought
a tear to my eye. 
I received the tomato from her and took a
hearty bite.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! Right~? After all,
I'm a farmer's girl! 
These are Katsuragi Ace-sama's homegrown
vegetables, you see!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I got it from the field I borrowed from the
academy, 
so it's a freshly picked tomato!
……If you're interested, 
want to take a look on your break?

Before Katsuragi Ace's training,
I went to look at her field. 
It seemed exceptionally well-maintained,
so I asked――
choice_data_list: Why are you borrowing this field?
Why are you borrowing this field?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, since I was young,
I've been helping out 
with the fields at home!
If I don't do a little field 
work in the mornings,
it just doesn't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……And so,
I asked the Chairman and then set 
this up!
My family had a laugh when they told 
me 『Even though you went to the city?!』.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Yesterday,
they sent me a picture of when we were
all 
working the fields saying 『A nostalgic
picture!』

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――It was still dark in the morning,
so we'd all head to the field in a line.
And if anyone 
yawned,
then everyone would end up doing it too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
『So you've appeared,
Yawning Bandit!』  we'd say, 
and it'd turn in to a game of tag!
In the end, 
Mom would end up carrying Dad along……how
nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everyone's doing alright~.
At this point, 
I could probably carry my dad too,
don't you think?

……Katsuragi Ace was probably feeling a little
lonely. 
Even though she was talking about something
pleasant, 
her tail was just swaying in the wind.

She was usually composed,
but she was still a student. 
I needed to keep it together and follow up
here――
choice_data_list: I want to try working the field too!
I want to try working the field too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Work the field……? 
What're you saying all of a sudden?

……though half of it was just out of
expedience. 
The real goal was to help console her.

While I couldn't become a replacement for
her family, 
I could at least make sure she wasn't
alone.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hehee, is that so!? 
……Alright! Then,
can you help me with the harvesting?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it,
you can take some too! 
There's alot after all!
……I'll go get some scissors!

I nodded in response.
Now I could just enjoy the harvest, 
so I squatted down in the tomato field――At
that moment――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!? 
Are you okay!? Is there a snake!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh?

I had fallen on my butt and was pointing. 
The caterpillar was on the stem of a
tomato.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a Swallowtail caterpillar. 
I guess seeing one up close would be kind
of shocking, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Alright, if you stay here,
you'll probably 
keep surprising this person, so, sorry,
but I'm gonna have to move you somewhere
else~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Alright, if you stay here,
you'll probably 
keep surprising this person, so, sorry,
but I'm gonna have to move you somewhere
else~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've let it go,
so it should be fine now! Seems like you 
fell on your butt,
but you didn't hurt your hips did you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I guess bugs are kinda scary if you're not
used to them. 
……right,
I'll take care of the harvesting then!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I feel bad making you do something you're
not used to. 
I'll get this done quick,
so just wait a bit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Tomatoes, cucumbers, and some corn too! 
I've already checked for insects so it should
be ready to eat!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's fine!
Taking some of the veggies helps me out
too. 
……Alright,
it's about time we get to training!

Saying that with a smile,
Katsuragi Ace left the field. 
……But I could still tell that she felt a
little lonely 
without her family.

What should I do to cheer up Katsuragi
Ace? 
I stared at the vegetables I'd received
while thinking about it.
